statements.impact_statement: The official Moby advisory GHSA-x4rx-4gw3-53p4 limits affected versions to 28.2.x through 28.3.2, fixed in 28.3.3. The exact installed Ubuntu package is 29.1.3-0ubuntu4.1, and CI additionally requires the actual dockerd --version output to be 29.1.3. Neither an unverified package version nor a different daemon can use this statement.

The original pip seed wheel is removed and replaced with pip 26.2.2+pasturestack.1, complete wheel SHA256 be5f63d537bbe611dc422fabb6740a44b5997888b592888df5091727f023802a, containing urllib3 2.8.0. The dpkg source-package version is retained for ABI dependency compatibility, not used as proof. CI verifies the actual ensurepip seed and live pip bytes, 299 vendored files, pip/urllib3 versions, and new venv/virtualenv installations. The statement fails closed for a changed wheel or an available FixedVersion.
